integrity: Theorem follows from the explicitly derived positive matrix renewal kernel and implicit analytic differentiation; numerical finite-chain tests corroborate but do not prove infinite-time or infinite-volume conclusions. Publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: A localized initial site, parity-two directional Lindblad jumps with four strictly positive rates and equal escape totals, and homogeneous nonzero coherent nearest-neighbor hopping; excludes arbitrary site-dependent loss, disorder, and correlated baths.
title: Exact diffusion and large deviations for a staggered quantum stochastic walk
